body:
P2-12 SLICE 4 (drawing), FOR THE ADVISOR. Docs only; nothing built; P2-12 stays todo; D-51 lets this slice merge, the code (slice 5) stays held.

DRAWN: a-cover-led.html, Search results (S-12), six new states at C and X (12 frames; #screen=search&state=assume-top&cls=C): assume-top (Top card is the guess), assume-notop, assume-symbols (ke$ha), assume-partial (library first, no line yet), assume-off (offline, no line), assume-none (no results, nothing assumed, no line). Inventory row S-12 and the design page's known differences updated. Looked at headless in Edge at 100 and 200 percent, right-to-left, light (Figtree could not load offline: fallback sans). No phone, no screen reader.

FOUND WHILE DRAWING
1. "landmarks" fires nothing: the recorded Deezer answer for it (tests/fixtures/deezer/search_artist_landmarks.json) already holds Landmarks and LANDMVRKS, so no extra request, no line. The frames use the owner's "landmrvk": 2 edits from LANDMVRKS whole (allowance 1), reachable only by the unfinished-name clause of PR #93, so the server's shared typo-rule.json must carry that clause.
2. Deezer spells the band LANDMVRKS, not "Landmvrks". Decided: the line shows the text as the server sent it: a known name in its own spelling; kind symbols = the typed text with symbols spelt out ("kesha" for "ke$ha", extra request 2). "pink" for P!nk is known-name. One sentence for both kinds; the kind is never shown.
3. No jump: the line is the first item of the list (scrolls away) and arrives in the SAME update as the catalogue's rows, never alone or later; applied when no finger is on the list; no gap kept (it would sit empty above almost every search). Rejected: below the list (unseen), a floating pill (covers rows).
4. Top result (decided, overrule freely): a guess takes the Top card only for an artist the person has (as the library's typo guess does today); else no card, the artist is the first row of Artists. Slice 5: assumed and not owned must stay under the Top bar (today 0.6 less the barely-known 0.1 is exactly 0.5).
5. The phone's own library guess (N-23a, built) stays silent, also offline: only the server says "also". If you want the line there too it is a phone-only follow-up (no server, no D-51); not drawn.
6. NOT tappable (my decision): the rows are the way in; the plan says the phone never changes the field; one more tap target and focus stop at 200 percent and RTL; a state after the tap; louder than "one quiet line"; a tap can be added later without changing the answer. Screen reader: one sentence, first after the field, not a live region. Recents keep the typed text.
7. A long capitals word (LANDMVRKS) does not fit beside cover and Play in the phone's Top card: drawn under them. LANDMVRKS song and album titles are examples; Kesha's are real. Arabic wording is a placeholder for a native check. The unbuilt "Closest" block of the first no-results frame is superseded.

TWO QUESTIONS
Q1 WORDING. Drawn: Also showing results for "LANDMVRKS" (the plan's suggestion; no "Did you mean": it says the person was wrong). Weighed, not taken: "Showing results for ... too", "Including results for ...". Ship this wording? Straight or curly quotes (the app's "No results for ..." is straight)?
Q2 TAPPABLE? Drawn plain. A tap would only retype the field with the suggestion; it is one more state and must be drawn before it is built. Do you want it?

NOT PROVEN: nothing built or walked; the "same update" and "no finger down" rules need a slice 5 widget test. docs/31-34 untouched.
